name: classic-strike
description: Browser-based tactical FPS inspired by classic Counter-Strike gameplay. Original code and assets.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist-server/server.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
